definitions.gloss: viewpoint, perspective, way of looking at something
definitions.explanation: A particular attitude or manner of considering something; one's perspective or point of view.
The method of reading or understanding something like a chart, map, or document.

examples.japanese: ⟦{物事|ものごと}→物事：00291_monogoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見方|みかた}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: Perspectives on things differ from person to person.

examples.japanese: {見方|みかた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えて→変える：01089_kaeru⟧みよう。

examples.english: Please teach me how to read a map.

notes:
WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{味方|みかた}→味方：03743_mikata⟧ (ally, supporter) - different kanji

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {見方|みかた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧ (to change one's perspective)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見方|みかた} (way of looking at ~)
- {見方|みかた}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ (depending on how you look at it)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {見方|みかた} vs. ⟦{観点|かんてん}→観点：05582_kanten⟧ vs. ⟦{視点|してん}→視点：03187_shiten⟧
  - {見方|みかた}: general word for viewpoint
  - ⟦{観点|かんてん}→観点：05582_kanten⟧: standpoint (more formal)
  - ⟦{視点|してん}→視点：03187_shiten⟧: point of view (often used in analysis)
